title: PEROXIDASE-LABELED ANTIBODY A NEW METHOD OF CONJUGATION
abstract: A new method of conjugating horseradish peroxidase with proteins was developed. The carbohydrate moiety of fluorodinitrobenzene-blocked peroxidase was oxidized with sodium periodate to form aldehyde groups. The peroxidase-aldehyde was then bound to free amino groups of proteins unidirectionally at high efficiencies. Peroxidase-labeled immunoglobulin retained its immunologic as well as enzymatic activities.
